description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.37.0-dualvot.7

### Stable Dual VoT release

- Graduates the tested Yandex countdown and player-button improvements from preview.
- Keeps the countdown halo centered across orientations, timer positions, thicknesses, and layouts with additional player buttons.
- Keeps the Yandex button state synchronized with translated playback.
- Makes the Yandex audio controls scrollable so voice style and proxy settings remain reachable on short landscape screens.
- Includes the improved new-video request flow and complete optional Yandex proxy routing.

### Included base

- Based on stable Morphe Patches 1.37.0.
- Includes both the built-in Google/other translation and Yandex translation with mutually exclusive player controls.
